Recurrent infections, diarrhea, and weight loss are better explained by thymoma-associated immunodeficiency, so systemic granulomatous disease is effectively excluded with confidence reduced to 0.02.

Confidence is 0.95 because the core criteria are met; only confirmatory tests remain incomplete.

The mediastinal mass is confirmed as type AB thymoma rather than lymphoma, and the biopsy shows no neoplastic infiltration. Expert analyses confirm Good syndrome and exclude lymphoproliferative neoplasm; weight loss is attributed to impaired oral intake, so confidence is reduced to 0.02.
